newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Airlines cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Airlines cut.

text.p: -- Dillon Read analyst Edward Starkman said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Northwest Airlines Corp to outperform from buy.

-- "While we still believe that NWAC looks undervalued on our earnings estimates, we are downgrading to reflect our perception of the relative attractiveness of the stock as compared with other network carriers that have a much cleaner positive story," the analyst said.

-- "Northwest has been especially hard hit by the weakness of the yen. They have the biggest Japan operation of any U.S. carrier. They are also very active in the Japanese tourist market bound for Pacific beaches. Those destinations have become relatively unattractive to Japanese tourists as the U.S. dollar looks expensive to them," according to the note.
-- Fully-diluted, per-share earnings projections are unchanged at $5.30 for 1997 and $4.85 for 1998.
-- Shares were up 7/8 to 39-1/8 in afternoon Nasdaq trade, off an earlier session-high of 39-7/8.
